about: Recipes for the quick track: what to do with a video or still the user drops in (or an editing tool takes from a timeline) and a few words. sc.py quick recipes picks one from the words and the file type; sc.py quick plan --recipe applies it to the card (model, mode, input role, what must stay, length). Read by sc.py, never loaded into chat context. 'models' lists profiled models in preference order; 'candidates' are live Higgsfield models that fit but have no profile in models.json yet (add them with model-scout before use).

relight.label: Relight
relight.keep: same scene, buildings, framing, subject and camera path; only the light changes
relight.tips: Name one key light (source, side of frame, height, hard or soft), the shadows it casts on named surfaces, warm/cool split, what stays dark. Ask for the light ON the subject's surfaces, not only the sky.
relight.known: Seedance 2.5 video_edit tends to change the sky more than the light on surfaces (Nov 2026 drone relight came back as a sky swap with a flat facade).

sky.label: Sky swap
sky.keep: everything below the skyline stays identical: buildings, trees, people, framing and camera path; only the sky changes
sky.tips: Describe the new sky (clear, cloud type, time of day) and that the scene's light matches it softly. A reference image of the sky helps (add it as --as reference on stills).

cleanup.label: Clean up / remove objects
cleanup.keep: everything else stays identical: framing, camera path, people, light and colour
cleanup.tips: Name exactly what goes and where ("the two wheelie bins at frame left"), and what fills the gap ("the brick wall continues"). One removal list per job; a frame grab with the area boxed avoids a wrong guess.

background.label: Change background
background.keep: the subject stays identical (face, hair, clothes, hands, motion, framing); only the background changes
background.tips: Describe the new place and match its light to the subject's key (side, warmth), or the subject looks pasted in.

animate.label: Animate a still
animate.tips: Motion only: one camera move with its speed and what moves in the scene. Never describe the frame again.

extend.label: Extend a clip
extend.tips: Describe what happens next and that the camera keeps its move and speed. Use extend_backward (sc.py card front matter source_edit) for a lead-in.
